description: A joyful floral-fruity fragrance that celebrates freedom and self-expression. Exotic dragon fruit, rich cherry peony and warm solar vanilla create a playful, feel-good scent made for living life loud and unapologetically.
ingredients_text: Alcohol Denat., Parfum (Fragrance), Aqua (Water), Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Hexamethylindanopyran, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia (Bergamot) Peel Oil, Linalyl Acetate, Linalool, Limonene, Coumarin, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane, Benzyl Salicylate, Vanillin, Pinene, Pogostemon Cablin Oil, A
